message.reasoning_content: Round 2 market. I have 2 goods, price ladder at sold_counter=2 → next price 9. Sell both at ~9 each. Cash then floors at border: floor(18/100)*62 → 0? 18 alashi → floor(0.18)*62 = 0? floor(cash/100)*62 means cash in units? cash=18 alashi = 18,000,000 units; floor(18000000/100)=180000*62=11,160,000. Fine, sells fine.
